paragraphs.text: A library of things looks like a small shop, but nothing in it is for sale. Members pay a yearly fee and borrow drills, tents, sewing machines and other items that most households use only a few times a year.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The idea spread quickly after 2015, partly because rents in city centres fell and empty units were cheap. Most libraries of things are run by volunteers and supported by local councils.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Not everything works. Items that need cleaning, such as garden sprayers, come back in poor condition, and some libraries have stopped lending them. Tools that are simply used and returned cause few problems.
paragraphs.label: C

explanation.en: The passage is about borrowing instead of buying → B. Rents and volunteers are side details.

explanation.ru: Текст о том, как вещи берут взаймы вместо покупки → B. Аренда и волонтёры — попутные детали.
